regions.name: Benalia

sentence.text: Benalia is the great human nation of western Aerona, a country of grain fields and limestone cities.

regions.set_piece: A gatehouse of New Benalia in white limestone with stained glass, and one floating spire of the Church of Serra above it.

regions.name: Shiv

sentence.text: Shiv is a land of active volcanoes, home to dragons, goblins, the viashino and the Ghitu.

regions.set_piece: The Mana Rig: a Thran works of metal towers and walkways on a basalt shelf above a river of lava.

regions.name: Llanowar

sentence.text: The elves of Llanowar keep to themselves in a vast old forest in the south of Aerona.

regions.set_piece: A grove of redwoods with elf platforms in the canopy and a warning post at the forest's edge.

regions.name: Yavimaya

sentence.text: Yavimaya is an island forest of trees as large as cities, in the Terisian Isles.

regions.set_piece: One magnigoth tree the size of a tower, with villages on its bark and roots that stand above the ground.

regions.name: Terisiare

sentence.text: Terisiare was a northern continent that has since broken into the Terisian Isles.

regions.set_piece: The mouth of the Caves of Koilos in a dry ridge, with the wreck of a dragon engine half buried before it.

regions.name: Sarpadia

sentence.text: Sarpadia is a remote southern continent where five cultures fell and the thrulls took the whole land.

regions.set_piece: A ruined Icatian wall overgrown with thallids at the edge of Havenwood.

regions.name: Tolaria

sentence.text: Tolaria was the island of Urza's academy, until Barrin's spell destroyed it.

regions.set_piece: The broken towers of the academy on a reef, with one bubble of slowed time in which the water hangs still.

regions.name: Caliman

sentence.text: Caliman is a large island in the far south, where magic and machines are used side by side.

regions.set_piece: An Alaborn watchtower with a musket rack above a harbour of Talas ships.

regions.name: Jamuraa

sentence.text: Jamuraa is the largest continent on the plane, a land of deserts, forests and city-states.

regions.set_piece: A Zhalfirin gate that opens on empty air, where the kingdom stood before it was phased away.

regions.name: Urborg

sentence.text: Urborg is a marsh-covered tropical island in the Burning Isles, long fought over by witches and necromancers.

regions.set_piece: The ruin of the Stronghold in the wall of a dormant volcano, with the Heroes' Memorial on the shore of a bog below.

regions.name: Otaria

sentence.text: Otaria is a narrow continent east of Jamuraa, once shared by nomads, barbarians, druids and the Cabal.

regions.set_piece: A sword driven into a mound at the edge of the Krosan Forest, with trees grown huge around it.

regions.name: Keld

sentence.text: The Keldons, tall grey-skinned warriors hardened to the cold, hold the north of Aerona.

regions.set_piece: A ring of Keldon megaliths on a bare ridge, with the prow of the Golden Argosy raised among them.
